jobs.text: Cinematic realistic film still, vertical composition. The same warm living room. The round beige plush cat bed and pale blanket are dissolving into empty air directly under the cat, a clear gap of nothing where the softness just was. The silver shaded British Shorthair is slipping downward, eyes just opening in surprise. Medium shot: the vanishing bed is the subject, the cat does not fill the frame, not a face portrait. No bowl, no text, no letters, no watermark.

jobs.text: Cinematic realistic film still, vertical composition. Dark spacecraft cabin, faint blue Earth glow through a high round porthole. A silver shaded British Shorthair floats in the midground with its mouth slightly open, looking down at a completely empty floor, waiting for a bowl that is not there. No water bowl, no food bowl, no dish anywhere in the frame. Medium-wide shot, the empty floor matters as much as the cat, the cat does not fill the frame. No text, no letters, no watermark.
